```{r}
library(pdftools)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Step 1: Read PDF
pdf_text_data <- pdf_text("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Fallberichte/Hepatitiden unter NSAR + FL/Einzelfälle_Ibuprofen, DE ab 1993, SMQ Hepatic disorders.pdf")
pdf_text_data

# Step 2: Combine all pages into one big text block
all_text <- paste(pdf_text_data, collapse = "\n")

# Step 3: Use regex to extract all DE-BFARM IDs
debfarm_ids <- str_extract_all(all_text, "DE-BFARM-\\d{8}") %>% unlist()

# Step 4: Remove duplicates and sort
unique_ids <- unique(debfarm_ids)
unique_ids <- sort(unique_ids)

# View result
print(unique_ids)

write.csv(data.frame(DE_BFARM_IDs = unique_ids), "Einzelfälle_Ibuprofen, DE ab 1993, SMQ Hepatic disorders.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
